name: Shadow Street
desc1: This wide, litter-cluttered street is paved with broken and chipped
desc2: flagstones. Tall, rickety buildings tower above on either side of the
desc3: street, their barred and curtained windows disquietingly watchful.
desc4: Flickering light is provided by lit torches fastened to the walls.
desc5: Through the window in a western building you can hear raucous laughter
desc6: and the sounds of fights, and to the east, a tall iron fence leads
desc7: into some sort of dark park. The street continues north and south.
